The PEA outlined annual production capacity of up to 70K metric tons of battery-quality lithium carbonate and 1.29M tons of total lithium carbonate production over a 20-year modeled operating life, with a starting lithium concentration of 562 mg/L and an average lithium concentration of 515 mg/L.

The preliminary assessment estimated an unlevered pre-tax net present value of $5.9B, a 25.7% internal rate of return, and a three-year payback period, with average annual lithium cash operating expenses of $4,226/ton and capital intensity of $49,945/ton.
Additionally, the report includes an upgraded and upsized mineral resource with some of the highest lithium-in-brine concentrations reported in North America, Standard Lithium

The principal recommendation of the preliminary economic assessment technical report was to advance the Franklin project to a preliminary feasibility study while continuing direct lithium extraction testing of the project brine.
